name: Phong Nha
provinceNote: The park’s own pages give the address as Phong Nha Commune, Quang Tri Province.
summary: A village beside a national park famous for its caves, about 50 km from Dong Hoi in central Vietnam. Take the boat along the Son River into Phong Nha Cave, walk the boardwalk in Paradise Cave, or book an expedition to Son Doong, then eat Son River fish and grilled chicken. Suits adventurous travellers and families alike.
timeNeeded: Half a day for the boat cave
fee: Phong Nha Cave entrance 150,000 VND. Boat 700,000 VND for up to 12, or 750,000 VND with Tien Son. Paradise Cave adult 270,000 VND, buggy included; Vietjet lists 250,000 VND. Paradise gate hours: Check on arrival. Son Doong 3,000 USD a person on the park page and on Oxalis; Oxalis also lists 80,000,000 VND. Dark Cave exploration 450,000 VND. Mooc Spring sightseeing 80,000 VND. Kayak 1,700,000 VND. Botanical garden 80,000 VND. OZO basic day ticket 200,000 VND. Hang En 9,500,000 VND or about 358 USD. Hang Va 9,400,000 VND, or about 346 USD on the park’s English page. Eight Ladies Cave is free. Sinh Ton Valley 1,650,000 VND for one day or 4,700,000 VND for two. Drive minutes, taxi, and rail: Check on arrival.
getThere: Dong Hoi Airport (VDH), then the road. The park puts the cave about 50 km from Dong Hoi.
bestMonths: Summer and winter boards, months unnamed
seoTitle: Phong Nha — the boat cave, Paradise Cave, Son Doong
seoDescription: Take the boat into Phong Nha Cave, walk Paradise Cave at Km 16, and book Son Doong as the six-day expedition. Sleep in the village for the morning boat.
intro: You take the boat from the Tourism Center down the Son River and into Phong Nha Cave. The engine stops, and the crew rows you about 1,200 metres of a cave the park measures at 7,729 metres. The visit is about two and a half hours. Sleep in the village if that morning is the trip. Head for Hue if you wanted the citadel.

Paradise Cave is the dry wooden walk at Km 16 on the west Ho Chi Minh road. A buggy or a forest path covers about 1.6 kilometres, then about 500 metres to the mouth, then about a kilometre inside a cave the park measures at 31.4 kilometres. The park’s adult price for that walk is 270,000 VND, buggy included. Vietjet lists 250,000 VND.

Son Doong is the expedition cave. Oxalis runs it as six days and five nights, from January to August, and there is no walk-up ticket. The park page and the operator both list 3,000 USD a person. The operator also lists 80,000,000 VND. Be in Dong Hoi by 15:00 for the briefing. On 21 Oct 2026 the operator said the 2027 and 2028 departures are fully booked.

Dark Cave and Mooc Spring are separate tickets. The Dark Cave exploration package is 450,000 VND and includes the cave. The cheaper packages leave it out. Mooc Spring’s sightseeing price is 80,000 VND and does not include the swim. The park puts the spring about 20 minutes from Phong Nha Cave. The 4,500-metre kayak in Phong Nha Cave is 1,700,000 VND. The botanical garden on Road 20 is 80,000 VND, about 10 km from the Tourism Center. OZO Park’s basic day ticket is 200,000 VND for an adult over 1.4 metres. Hang En is two days at 9,500,000 VND, or about 358 USD, on the Oxalis page. Hang Va’s Oxalis price is 9,400,000 VND for two days, while the park’s English page lists about 346 USD. Eight Ladies Cave, at the Road 20 memorial, is free. Sinh Ton Valley is 1,650,000 VND for one day or 4,700,000 VND for two, from Km 19 on the west Ho Chi Minh road.
gettingAround: Dong Hoi Airport (VDH) is the air gateway. The park puts Phong Nha Cave about 50 km from Dong Hoi city. At the cave, buy the ticket at the Tourism Center and walk to the pier on the left. Paradise Cave is at Km 16 on the west Ho Chi Minh road.

stayAreas.name: Phong Nha village
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here if the boat leaves in the morning. The Tourism Center is the start of that visit. Dong Hoi is the airport, about 50 km from the cave.

eat: Son River grass carp is the fish Quảng Bình’s visitor pages call the emblem of eating at Phong Nha-Ke Bang. Grilled chicken comes with muối cheo and sticky rice. Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park names cơm pồi, Láp, and rượu đoác in the buffer villages.
interestsBody: The boat into Phong Nha Cave is the morning. Paradise Cave is the dry walk at Km 16, on its own ticket.
Chay River and Mooc Spring are the swim, on tickets that do not include the boat. The exploration package is the one that enters Dark Cave. Mooc’s 80,000 VND row is the walk, not the swim.

Son Doong is the expedition cave, six days with Oxalis. The evening is the village after the boards close. The summer boat board ends at 16:30, and the winter board ends at 15:45. The park does not name which months those are.

season.label: Check the board
season.note: The park says the Son River runs jade-green in the dry season and reddish in the rainy season, and it does not name those months. Chay River–Dark Cave may close in heavy rain, flooding, or storms. The summer boat board ends at 16:30 and the winter board ends at 15:45. The park does not name which months those are.

faqs.q: Does the Phong Nha Cave ticket include the boat?
faqs.a: The entrance is 150,000 VND. The boat is 700,000 VND for the round trip, for up to 12 people. Adding Tien Son on that same boat is 750,000 VND.

faqs.q: Can you visit Son Doong on your own?
faqs.a: Oxalis runs it as a six-day, five-night expedition from January to August. The park page and the operator both list 3,000 USD a person. The operator also lists 80,000,000 VND. Be in Dong Hoi by 15:00 for the briefing. On 21 Oct 2026 the operator said the 2027 and 2028 departures are fully booked.

faqs.q: Is Paradise Cave the same visit as the boat?
faqs.a: Paradise Cave is the dry cave at Km 16 on the west Ho Chi Minh road. The park’s one-kilometre adult ticket is 270,000 VND and includes the buggy. Vietjet lists 250,000 VND.
